caseNameFull: HONEYWOOD v. ROCKEFELLER, GOVERNOR OF NEW YORK
attorneys: Moses M. Falk for appellants., Louis J. Lefkowitz, Attorney General of New York, Irving Galt, Assistant Solicitor General, Sheldon Raab, Assistant Attorney General, and Irving D. Goodstein for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed. Wright v. Rockefeller, ante, p. 52.
